zero_test.user_report: yea, it seems like it is not a new zero position. hitting SHTL does stop it, but if I reverse the wheel from that 4x position it starts moving forward again at 3x, 2x, etc

mode_entry_observation.user_report: if I hit SHTL to stop it, then select JOG or SCRL, then go back to SHTL, where I left the wheel is the new zero position
mode_entry_observation.behavior: Re-entering SHTL from JOG/SCRL establishes the current wheel position as the new neutral; re-pressing the already-selected SHTL stops playback while retaining the existing neutral.
mode_entry_observation.evidence_type: Direct user observation, consistent with earlier captured hardware mode-entry reset
mode_entry_observation.limitations: This newly described leave-and-return sequence was not recorded in a fresh trace. Earlier trace captured SHTL mode entry programming zero and a zero-position input.

limitations: Speed readings are human-reported and not synchronously sampled with HID timestamps.
Values are sampled plateau positions, not speed transition thresholds or a fitted response function.
The earlier +1718/3x point is excluded because the user subsequently reported 2x/3x fluctuation.
Reverse speed has an unsigned display magnitude; signed speed in this ledger encodes direction.
Forward 10x was estimated by the user to be 90 degrees from neutral; no angular calibration is inferred.
Unmeasured reverse rates are not filled in by symmetry.
